headline: Nimbus Projects incorporates IITL Nimbus The Express Park View as a subsidiary
hook: New subsidiary added at Nimbus Projects
summary: Nimbus Projects has announced the incorporation of IITL Nimbus The Express Park View Private Limited as a subsidiary company. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. This corporate action expands the company's subsidiary network within its business operations. Retail investors should note how corporate structuring affects consolidated financial reporting.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary addition changes group financial structure.

summary: Nimbisprojects has announced the incorporation of a new subsidiary company in an intimation filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.
